name: Special Meeting Memo
agenda_text:
The City of San Diego
Office of Council President Joe LaCava
First District
M e m o r a n d u m
date: September 24, 2026
to: Honorable City Councilmembers
from: Council President Joe LaCava, District 1
subject: Special City Council Meeting and Adjournment of Regular Meeting
_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________
The regularly scheduled City Council Meeting on Monday, September 28, 2026, has been adjourned. In its stead, the City Council will convene for a Special Meeting on Monday, September 28, 2026, during the following times.
The Council will convene at 10:00am in Open Session to hear the following items:
Public Comment on Closed Session items
The Council will then recess into Closed Session and reconvene at 2:00 p.m. to hear the following:
Consent agenda items: Approval of Council Minutes
Award a Construction Contract with Skanska USA Civil West California District Inc, for the El Camino Real to Via De La Valle (1/2 Mile) Project
Re-approval of the Second Amended and Restated Regional Wastewater Disposal Agreement With the Metropolitan Wastewater Joint Powers Authority
Approval of a Third Amendment to the Grant Agreement with the County of San Diego for the Domestic Violence Shelter
Approval of a First Amendment to the Subrecipient Grant Agreement with the County of San Diego for the Riverbed Encampment Resolution Funding Project
17th & Commercial Apartments - First Amendment to Regulatory Agreement and Loan Documents
Declare six City-owned parcels with Assessor Parcel Numbers 548-450-13, 587-420-02, 425-012-22, 425-012-24, 465-273-06, and 591-100-40, “exempt surplus land” pursuant to California Government Code Section 54221(f)(1)(B)
Appointment to the Commission on Gang Prevention and Intervention
Appointment to the San Diego City Employees’ Retirement System Board of Administration
Appointment to the Senior Affairs Advisory Board
Appointment to the Youth Commission
Reappointments to the Climate Advisory Board
Honorary Street Name: Recognition of Marty Judge Way on the 15600 block of Avenida Venusto and Caminito Corriente according to San Diego Municipal Code Section 125.1130, “Honorary Street Names,” and Council Policy 200-10, “Honorary Street Names.”
Approval of a Request for a Conflict-of-Interest Waiver from Selman Leichenger Edson Hsu Newman & Moore LLP
Discussion agenda items: 11370 Paymogo Court - Appeal of the Environmental Determination Project Number PRJ-0573108
Report out from Closed Session
Non-agenda public comment
The City Council will resume its regular order of business on Tuesday, September 29, 2026, at 10:00am at the City Administration Building, in City Council Chambers on the 12 th floor of 202 “C” Street.
If you have questions, please contact Luz Anaya Luna, Director of Legislative Affairs, at (619) 235-5880 or lanayaluna@sandiego.gov and Heidi Palmer, Legislative Analyst, at (619) 533-3920 or palmerh@sandiego.gov .
cc: Honorable Mayor Todd Gloria
Honorable City Attorney Heather Ferbert
Charles Modica, Independent Budget Analyst
Diana Fuentes, City Clerk
